Name: Lumisteria More Flowery Grass - Eemie Palette
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: This mod is a content pack for the "More Grass" mod. It adds a lot of flowery grass in spring, summer and fall. It uses Eemie's grass palette and two different options to choose.
Description:
This mod is a content pack for the "[More Grass](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398)" Mod, using Eemie's grass palette.
It adds a lot of flowery grass in spring, summer, and fall. There are two packs, one with flowers of vivid color, the other with toned down flowers. Main download include both.
